name: claude-coach
description: Coaching for Claude Code: a coach for your commands, and a drill master for your DevOps way of working.

plugins.name: coach
plugins.description: A coach for your Claude Code commands: captures corrections from a session and applies them back to the command.

plugins.name: devops-drillmaster
plugins.description: A drill master for a DevOps way of working: sets up processes and policies around your objective and toolchain, keeps a field log on every issue and PR, and runs after-action reviews that change the process one experiment at a time.
